themes_detail.label: Park Noise Surge
themes_detail.summary: Park noise complaints spiked to 12 THIS WEEK, a 357% increase from the 8-week average of 2.6 weekly complaints (z-score: 4.43), suggesting a sudden deterioration in park conditions or enforcement during peak season.
evidence: 12 park noise complaints filed THIS WEEK vs. 2.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
357% spike with z-score of 4.43 (high statistical significance)
Aligns with ongoing community board requests for park maintenance and safety improvements
reporting_angles: Interview Parks Department about staffing and enforcement capacity during peak season in Jackson Heights parks
Talk to residents about which parks are affected and what times of day noise is worst

themes_detail.label: Dead Trees & Animals Outbreak
themes_detail.summary: Dead/dying tree complaints reached 5 THIS WEEK (300% spike from 1.2 weekly average) concurrent with 9 dead animal complaints last week (454% spike from 1.6 average), suggesting potential environmental health or sanitation crisis in the district.
evidence: 5 dead/dying tree complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.2 weekly average (z-score: 5.67)
9 dead animal complaints last week vs. 1.6 weekly average (z-score: 5.6)
Consecutive weeks of environmental distress signals potential drought, disease, or ecological stress in district
reporting_angles: Contact Parks Department and DEP about tree health status and any pest or disease outbreaks affecting the district
Investigate whether recent weather patterns or neighborhood conditions are contributing to animal mortality

themes_detail.label: Cannabis Retailer Complaints Spike
themes_detail.summary: Cannabis retailer complaints jumped to 3 THIS WEEK, a 700% increase from the 0.4 weekly baseline (z-score: 5.42), indicating rapid emergence of unlicensed or non-compliant cannabis operations in Jackson Heights.
evidence: 3 cannabis retailer complaints filed THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (z-score: 5.42)
700% spike suggesting rapid proliferation of unlicensed or problem establishments
Aligns with ongoing community board budget requests for small business services oversight
reporting_angles: Map where the 3 complaints originated and visit those locations to document any unlicensed cannabis retail operations
Interview SBS and NYPD about enforcement capacity and whether they've noticed an uptick in illegal cannabis dispensaries in Queens

themes_detail.label: Air Quality Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Air quality complaints reached 4 THIS WEEK, nearly triple the 1.4 weekly average (191% spike, z-score: 5.42), suggesting localized air pollution or emissions issues that have abruptly worsened.
evidence: 4 air quality complaints filed THIS WEEK vs. 1.4 weekly average (z-score: 5.42)
191% increase clustered in single week suggests acute event rather than chronic condition
Intersects with environmental concerns flagged by dead tree/animal complaints and community DEP budget requests
reporting_angles: Check EPA and DEP air quality monitors for Jackson Heights/Elmhurst to see if sensors detected pollution spike this week
Interview residents filing complaints about what they observed (smells, haze, industrial activity) and cross-check with nearby industrial facilities or traffic patterns

themes_detail.label: Building/Use Violations Surge
themes_detail.summary: Building/use complaints spiked to 22 last week, a 175% increase from the 8-week average of 8.0 weekly complaints (z-score: 7.23), indicating a sudden wave of code violations or illegal occupancy issues.
evidence: 22 building/use complaints last week vs. 8.0 weekly average (z-score: 7.23)
175% spike suggests rapid emergence of code violations or illegal conversions
282 DOB building permits filed in past 90 days (229 alterations) suggests active construction activity that may be generating complaints
Aligns with ongoing HPD budget requests from community board
reporting_angles: Query DOB permit data to identify which addresses are generating the most building complaints and what work is being done
Interview HPD about whether they're seeing a pattern of illegal conversions, overcrowding, or unpermitted work in Jackson Heights
